subject: Set up data from multiple tissues for Group means-based testing

messages.author: 71755fba910dfee9
messages.subject: Set up data from multiple tissues for Group means-based testing
parts:
Hello,

I have a query about how to set up data for Group means-based testing.

I have 6 individual imzml files (each is a different slide). In each imzml file, there are four tissues, each one corresponding to one of four conditions. How do I label this for statistical analysis?

My plan was to use
controlA <- selectROI(mydata, mz=766, subset=run(mydata) == "run0" )
controlB <- selectROI(mydata, mz=766, subset=run(mydata) == "run1" )
Condition1A <- selectROI(mydata, mz=766, subset=run(mydata) == "run0" )
Condition1B <- selectROI(mydata, mz=766, subset=run(mydata) == "run1" )
etc to generate an ROI for each tissue sample (in each run)

and then label these as treatment to include in further statistical testing, by using
diagnosis <- makeFactor(control=controlA, condition1= Condition1A ) etc
This works fine when I just assign a single ROI to each diagnosis as above. However, I have multiple ROIs which are control, multiple which are condition 1 etc.

Is it possible to do this? I tried variations of:
diagnosis  <- makeFactor(control=controlA&controlB, condition1=Condition1A&Condition1B)

But this doesn't seem to work..

Any advice would be greatly appreciated!

Best wishes,
Sandra :)
